_comment: The Parent Volunteers page. Leave a button's "url" empty and it shows as a grey 'coming soon' box instead of a link.
lead: The Little Mermaid JR. takes a whole crew of grown-ups as well as a cast of 38. Pick anything below that suits you, and thank you!

committees.heading: Ways to help
committees.intro: Every bit of help counts, from an hour at one rehearsal to a whole run of shows.

items.name: Costumes and Props
items.what: Helping to thrift, make and/or buy costumes and props.

items.name: Set Design and Construction
items.what: Helping to design and build our sets.

items.name: Rehearsal help
items.what: Helping to supervise students and small groups during rehearsals.

items.name: Performance frontstage help
items.what: Photographer or videographer during performances, concessions, programs and more.

closing: All Help is greatly appreciated. Lets make this a great show for our students! Thank you for your support!
